title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Maa Bhuvaneswari
desc: A woman relies on her faith in Goddess Soundarya to endure a man's dark magic practices.

title: Shoorveer
desc: Siddharth, a fashion editor who hates horses, decides to venture into the world of horse racing to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Vijay The Master
desc: Troubled alcoholic teacher JD goes to work at a juvenile reform school. When he realises a dangerous criminal is using students to cover up his crimes, JD sets out to stop him.

title: Khoonkhaar
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

title: The Hero: Love Story of a Spy
desc: Arun Khanna, an Indian spy, collaborates with Reshma to stop a nuclear attack. However, Reshma's identity is compromised during her undercover mission in Pakistan.
